question: In a certain code language 'SNOW' is written as 'HMLD'. How will 'MIST' be written as in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c5c942bdefa06e9d0fda44684c03b992ed7ae8cea33bfb4425e76e5c9e8fee1b.png] 

The logic followed here is:

'SNOW' is written as 'HMLD'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7cd2f13fbc2b0704e3df59f188a4075a83f57655e5a5458246b34f012d9de678.png] 

Similarly, 

'MIST' will be written:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dc5a8aca208c1d58b223bbf2eb018d556c80f4ced2ba62d191fa7fb825f91f68.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is** "NRHG".**
